scope: AST-only source analysis; no report execution, database, provider, candidate, legacy stack, or secret access

change.behavior: Propagate parent-row location scope into child queries inside try and if branches using branch-local inference state; do not merge state between branches.
regressions: A location-filtered Statement of Work parent row scopes its sow_deliverable, sow_payment_schedule, and sow_change_request queries.
A location-filtered EBF scorecard summary scopes its v_public_ebf_scorecard child query.
An unscoped branch replacement does not inherit the previous parent-row scope.

limitations: A source scope signal does not prove database authorization, RLS, correct view lineage, tenant isolation, PostgreSQL execution, or semantic report parity.
Report-owner decisions, populated reference outputs, and MAN-CAP-066 acceptance remain open.
